author_note: Written only from workflows/*.yaml (all 13 contracts) and scripts/workflow_registry.py; no other file was opened and no model was called. Each gold follows from contract text quoted in evidence: DO when a workflow's stated inputs, sizes and exposed settings cover the request; PARTIAL (shape a) when a named workflow can run but a requested setting is not one of its controls; DECLINE when a stated minimum sample count, layer count or other contract condition fails for the only result asked; ASK when one stated-uncertain fact flips the outcome (both branches checked, arithmetic recomputed: LIONESS-DRAGON values = F(F-1)/2 x samples against 20,000,000, COBRA genes vs samples); CLARIFY when no concrete result is named. Items were shuffled with random.Random(20261024) before ids were assigned.
